name: wadi-mcp
description: MCP server for the Wadi house designer — check, preview, and reference the Wadi DSL (.wdl) without the repo.
author: bijoor

scripts.dev: npm run gen-parser && npm run gen-assets && tsx src/server.ts
scripts.smoke: npm run gen-parser && npm run gen-assets && tsx scripts/smoke.mjs
scripts.build: npm run gen-parser && npm run gen-assets && node esbuild.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run smoke
